Name: BFAV Wyverns
Author: Murrthecat
Description:
This mod adds wyverns as a barn animal to the game using Paritee's Better Farm Animal Variety, found [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3296]here[/url]. The BFAV 3.0 unofficial update is needed.

There are six different types of wyverns -Standard, Batlike, Devil, Gargoyle, Ice, and Starry- that can be purchased from Marnie after you get the Deluxe Barn. Each wyvern drops a wyvern scale, but will also occasionally drop iridium ore. They aren't really meant to be profitable; I just think wyverns are neat.

Credits:

Big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/55350592]Silverdusk10 [/url]for redesigning the adult sprites and adding all new baby sprites. They also added a new animal shop icon. Due to Silverdusk10's hard work, the wyverns look much better and in-line with the Stardew Valley style.

Thank you to Mythicas for letting me use their beautiful [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2989]dragon statue sprite mod[/url] to base the sprites off of. Also, thank you to Stardewforest for guiding me through the process of making a mod for BFAV. Please check out their cool [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3737]crow mod for BFAV[/url].

Installation Instructions:

Simply download both files and add them to your Mods folder.
